nodes.name: Entrance Hall
nodes.summary: Dust-sheeted furniture and a stopped clock; the last public room of the house, where visitors were received and refused.

nodes.name: Long Gallery
nodes.summary: A corridor of portraits with their faces turned to the wall. Something was being hidden even from the paintings.

nodes.name: Private Study
nodes.summary: Harrow's inner sanctum: ledgers, a cold hearth, and the uncatalogued thing the whole house was locked around.
